## OSIRIS-REx Returned 121.6 Grams of Bennu Material

OSIRIS-REx returned material from Bennu to Earth on September 24, 2023. The mission required at least 60 grams, and that amount had already been exceeded before the sampling head was completely opened.

A final pour added another 51.2 grams. The completed inventory totaled 121.6 grams, distinguishing the mission’s minimum requirement from the final amount accounted for.
